title: Aft Pressure Bulkhead Radial Splice — Splice Plate Doubling Repair

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Permanent doubling repair for an indication found at the outer fastener row of an aft pressure bulkhead radial splice, adding a second splice plate on the forward face over the affected row.

sections.purpose: This repair restores the hoop load path across a radial splice of the aft pressure bulkhead after an eddy current indication has been found at the outer fastener row, without removing the original splice plate.
sections.damage_assessment: Confirm the indication by eddy current inspection from both faces where access allows, and by dye penetrant inspection of the exposed edge. Record the angular position of the splice, the fastener number and the amplitude of the indication. An indication at a single fastener that stays inside the allowable limits below may be repaired by this scheme. Two or more indications on the same splice, an indication that reaches the splice plate edge, or any indication on a splice that already carries a repair, are outside the scope and require an engineering assessment. Establish the airframe flight cycle count before you start, because the repair life is expressed against it.
sections.repair_procedure: Remove the fastener at the indication and the two fasteners either side of it. Ream each hole to the first oversize and do an eddy current inspection of each reamed hole. Where the indication is not removed at the first oversize, ream to the second oversize and repeat; a hole that still shows an indication at the second oversize is outside the scope of this repair. Cut the doubling splice plate VED957765-29 to the layout of the repair drawing and offer it to the forward face over the affected fastener row, picking up the reamed holes and the pattern given on the drawing. Add the transition plate D5170003921659 at the inboard end so that the load is diffused rather than stopped abruptly. Drill and ream the new positions using the plate as a template, keeping the edge distance on the drawing. Deburr every hole and apply the surface protection of the standard practice. Install both plates wet with sealant using rivets AGS611113-6C at the outer rows and oversize fasteners at the reamed positions. Fit tubular spacers EN347648-1B where the plate crosses the existing stringer foot. Seal the plate perimeter continuously and prove the pressure seal by the leak check in the applicable maintenance task.
sections.inspection_requirements: The repair is life limited to 12 000 flight cycles from the date of embodiment. Do a repeat eddy current inspection of the reamed fastener positions and of the plate perimeter every 3 000 flight cycles, and a detailed visual inspection of the seal at every heavy check. A new indication anywhere on the repaired splice invalidates the repair. The repair must be reported to Aeralis, and an aircraft carrying it may not be released without confirming that the widespread fatigue damage record has been updated.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: A single eddy current indication at one fastener of the outer row, removable at the second oversize, not closer than 60 mm to the splice plate edge and not on a splice that already carries a repair.

materials.description: SPLICE PLATE, METALLIC REPAIR PRACTICES, KIT

type_data.fastener_pattern: Three staggered rows of 32 rivets AGS611113-6C at 22 mm pitch and 16 mm edge distance, with oversize fasteners at the three reamed positions
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Repair is life limited to 12 000 flight cycles; repeat eddy current inspection every 3 000 flight cycles.
